asideNextText: Splitting a group instead of picking from it? The Team Generator divides a list into balanced teams.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling and unbiased shuffling — the same quality of randomness used by security software, not the predictable Math.random().
When it's on, each picked entry is removed from the pool, so sequential draws (1st prize, 2nd prize…) can never repeat a winner.
Blank lines are ignored. Duplicate entries are kept as separate entries — a name pasted twice has two chances, which is usually what you want for weighted entries.
faq.q: Do blank lines or duplicates matter?

heroSubtitle: Paste your entries, pick fairly — giveaways, classroom draws, and decisions, settled in one click.
metaDescription: Pick a random winner or selection from any list — names, entries, options. Fair cryptographic draw, optional remove-after-pick for sequential draws. Free.
title: Random Picker — Pick a Winner from a List | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: For regulated promotions, sweepstakes, or anything with legal or monetary stakes, use your official audited draw process — this is an everyday fairness tool, not a certified draw service.
It can't detect duplicate people entered under different names or spellings.
